title: Reinforcement preserves expected share
hook: Two stated cases: explore the mean of reinforced paths rather than a deterministic limit.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the mean of reinforced paths rather than a deterministic limit affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines ExpectedRedShare, regardless of the stated inputs.
